name: Drip Capital
long_description:
Drip is a financial technology company building modern infrastructure to make trade finance and B2B commerce easy and accessible for small businesses worldwide. Its AI native, predictive underwriting, and processing engine streamlines credit assessment and automates end-to-end transaction workflows. To date, Drip has facilitated more than $8 billion in cross-border trade for 11,000 businesses across 60 countries.
Working to close the $1.8 trillion global trade finance gap, Drip enables small and midsize businesses to trade with confidence across borders. The company has built a strong partner ecosystem — including leading capital providers such as Barclays, TD Bank, and the IFC, as well as logistics firms, insurance brokers, and B2B invoicing platforms — to expand distribution and impact. Drip is backed by global investors including Accel, Sequoia, Wing VC, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, GMO Payments, TD Bank, and Y Combinator.
one_liner: Digital trade finance and B2B commerce company

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Pushkar Mukewar is the Founder & CEO of Drip, a digital trade finance and commerce platform he started in 2016 with the mission of making global trade simple and accessible for small businesses. Drip builds modern, AI-native infrastructure that streamlines credit assessment and automates end-to-end trade workflows for exporters and importers worldwide.

Under Pushkar’s leadership, Drip has facilitated over $8 billion in cross-border trade, serving 11,000+ sellers and buyers across 60+ countries.
